messages:
Maya R: Hi team — my calendar shows two different times for the onboarding event (one at 08:00 and one at 16:00 local). The Zoom link on the earlier one asks for a passcode but the invite body has none. I'm on NZDT so worried I'll miss the right one. Anyone know which to join?
Jared (People Ops): Sorry about the confusion — we published a corrected ICS but some clients kept the old instance. Keep the event with organizer 'People Ops' and updated at 1798001230. We removed the passcode from the meeting; if Zoom still asks, use the fallback URL in this thread.
DevEx Bot: New ICS posted: https://redwood.internal/ics/onboarding/1798001234. Fallback join: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (if prompted for passcode use Meeting ID 123 456 789 and Passcode 4321). ICS includes explicit timezone fields to prevent client mislabeling.
Ian (IT): If you see duplicates: delete both and then import the linked ICS. On desktop, clearing Zoom cache (Help -> Troubleshooting -> Clear Cache) forces fresh meeting metadata. We'll also attach the recording to the corrected event after processing.
Priya L: I'm CET and had the same dupes. Re-importing fixed the display and the join link worked w/o passcode. Recording will be in Drive /Onboarding/Live-Recordings and shared to @new-hires.
Maya R: Re-imported and confirmed 16:00 NZDT (that's the correct local slot). Fallback worked when I tested. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Jared (People Ops): Great — we'll post the Drive link here and update the event notes after upload. Ping if anyone still can't access it.
